name: Convert thalamic segmentation into parcellation
summary: Converts FreeSurfer thalamic nuclei segmentation (ThalamicNuclei.*.FSvoxelSpace.mgz) into a volumetric parcellation in T1 space with a label.json.
description: Converts the thalamic nuclei segmentation with mri_convert, resamples it to the T1 grid with mri_vol2vol (nearest neighbour), and renumbers voxel values with a bundled label table (nibabel). Run FreeSurfer's thalamic nuclei segmentation first; the output can be used as ROIs for tractography or network analysis.

inputs.description: FreeSurfer subject directory (FreeSurfer 7) containing the thalamic nuclei (ThalamicNuclei.v*.T1.FSvoxelSpace.mgz) segmentation files in mri/.
T1-weighted image that defines the output space and voxel grid.
inputs.requirements: Must be in the same space as the FreeSurfer input (resampled with --regheader).

outputs.description: Thalamic nuclei parcellation (parc.nii.gz) on the T1 grid with label.json.

parameters.description: Which FreeSurfer segmentation to convert: thal (thalamic nuclei), hippamyg (hippocampal subfields and amygdala nuclei) or both. Fixed for this App.
Which hippocampal/amygdala segmentation level to use (FreeSurfer hippoAmygLabels files): default (full detail), CA, FS60 or HBT. Ignored for thalamic nuclei.
